verdict.rationale: Column's own docs state that it opens FDIC-insured bank accounts on behalf of customers and supports FBO, sweep, clearing and custom account types, with FBO storage for payment origination [column-docs-2][column-docs-17]. Custom Roles restrict access down to specific bank accounts, which partly answers who can see account data [column-docs-19]. Nothing in the pack plainly explains where FDIC insurance actually attaches (pass-through to end customers versus the FBO pool), so the core transparency claim is only partly documented. Missing for 10: explicit FDIC pass-through/attachment documentation, a plain explanation of FBO-pool vs individual-account fund placement, documentation of end-customer or regulator ledger visibility, independent corroboration.
